    AllowsReflectionRemapper
    Adds the AllowsReflection stereotype to the LangChain4j annotations that LangChain4j reads reflectively from the Java class (@SystemMessage, @UserMessage, @V, @Agent, @SequenceAgent, @Description, ...), so that a compiler generating the Java class for a declaration written in another language (the Python compiler) copies them onto the generated class without the user declaring @AllowsReflection or the micronaut.introspection.allow-reflection option.
    AllowsReflectionRemapper.Agentic
    The @Agent annotation.
    AllowsReflectionRemapper.AgenticDeclarative
    The declarative agentic annotations: @SequenceAgent, @ParallelAgent, @Output, ...
    AllowsReflectionRemapper.AiServices
    The annotations of AI services: @SystemMessage, @UserMessage, @V, @MemoryId, ...
    AllowsReflectionRemapper.StructuredOutputs
    The @Description annotation of the structured outputs.
    AllowsReflectionRemapper.Tools
    The tool annotations: @Tool, @P, @ToolMemoryId, ...

    ChatMemoryConfiguration

    CompensateForAnnotationTransformer
    Makes the CompensateFor methods executable, so that the tool registry finds them without reflection and reports that their compensating actions are not registered.
    ContentRetrieverConfiguration
    Configures a EmbeddingStoreContentRetriever that retrieves the segments of an embedding store relevant to the user message.

    Registers a LangChain4j decision service: an interface whose methods are answered by a DecisionModel, created with DecisionServices.

    Implements the DecisionService interfaces with LangChain4j's DecisionServices.

    EvaluationAssertions
    Assertions of evaluation results.
    EvaluationRequest
    Captures the prompt, optional context, and generated response for an evaluation.
    EvaluationResult
    Represents the result of an evaluation.
    EvaluationSample
    A sample of an evaluation: the input sent to the AI service, with the optional context that the response must be grounded in and the optional expected response, loaded from a sample file by EvaluationSamples.
    EvaluationSamples
    Loads evaluation samples from a YAML (or JSON) file of the classpath: a list of samples, or a map with a samples list.
    EvaluationSamplesSource
    Provides the evaluation samples of a classpath file to a JUnit ParameterizedTest, one invocation per sample.
    Evaluator
    Evaluates an AI response against a request.
    ExecutableMethodToolExecutor
    A LangChain4j ToolExecutor that invokes a Tool method of a bean through its Micronaut ExecutableMethod, with a ToolSpecification built from the compile-time annotation metadata and argument names of the method.
    FactCheckingEvaluator
    Evaluates whether the generated response is grounded in the supplied context.

    NativeImageMetadataVisitor
    Writes the GraalVM native image metadata (META-INF/native-image/.../reachability-metadata.json) of the types LangChain4j still reads and implements reflectively: the AI service interfaces, which LangChain4j implements with Proxy and whose methods, annotations and parameters it reads reflectively, and the agentic services and agents, which LangChain4j also implements with proxies combining the agent type with its own interfaces and whose static @Agent, @Output, @ExitCondition, ...

    ResponseFormatSchemas
    The JSON schemas of the structured outputs of one AI service or agent, keyed by the name LangChain4j gives the schema of the response format (the simple name of the return type, or List_of_<Type> for a list).
    RetrievalAugmentorConfiguration
    Configures a DefaultRetrievalAugmentor that retrieves content from one or more content retrievers and, with a scoring model, re-ranks it.
    RetrievalUtils
    Resolves the retrieval augmented generation (RAG) configuration of an AI or agentic service.
    RoutingChatModelConfiguration
    Configures a RoutingChatModel: a ChatModel bean that sends each request to one of several chat models, chosen by a ChatModelRouter.
    ScriptedChatModel
    A chat model for tests that answers each request with the first matching rule, and records the requests.
    ScriptedChatModel.Answer
    The answer of a rule.
    ScriptedChatModel.Builder
    Builds the rules of a ScriptedChatModel, evaluated in order.
    SerdeImportVisitor
    When Micronaut Serialization is on the annotation processor path, imports into it (@SerdeImport) the records LangChain4j maps to and from JSON: the structured outputs of the AI services and agents, and the parameters and results of the tools, with the records they are made of.
    SerdeJsonCodecFactory
    Registers the SerdeJsonCodec as LangChain4j's general purpose JSON codec (dev.langchain4j.internal.Json), ahead of other factories.
    SkillsConfiguration
    Configures a set of Agent Skills, exposed as a LangChain4j Skills bean named after the configuration, and offered to the AI services that select it with AiService.skills().
    StructuredOutputConfiguration
    Configuration of the structured outputs backed by generated JSON schemas.
    StructuredOutputSchemaProvider
    Supplies the JSON schema sent to the chat model when an AiService or agent method returns the given type, instead of the schema LangChain4j derives reflectively.
    StructuredOutputSchemas
    Configures the AI services and agents whose methods return a type with a schema supplied by a StructuredOutputSchemaProvider (by default, a type annotated with io.micronaut.jsonschema.JsonSchema), so that this schema is sent to the chat model as the structured output format.
    SuiteCondition
     
    TokenStreamToPublisherAdapter
    Lets AI service methods return a Reactive Streams Publisher<String>, the reactive type of the Micronaut APIs, with any streaming chat model: the partial responses are streamed like with Reactor's Flux<String>, which langchain4j-reactor supports and which is the Publisher returned.
